courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Principles of Accounting
courses.description: Financial and managerial accounting principles. Basic accounting statements, processes, and management applications.    Open to all students.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Principles of Financial Accounting
courses.description: First course in concepts and methods underlying financial statements.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Principles of Managerial Accounting
courses.description: Second course in the elementary series covering managerial problems and control of business operations.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Business Law in the Environment
courses.description: Introduction to legal principles and institutions affecting business.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Introduction to Accounting 2
courses.description: Additional issues in financial and managerial accounting. Review of issues related to balance sheet accounts, performance evaluation and capital budgeting.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Principles of Accounting 2
courses.description: Additional issues in financial and managerial accounting.  Review of issues related to balance sheet accounts, performance evaluation and capital budgeting.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Business and Accounting Information Systems
courses.description: Study of inputs, processing, outputs, and files of several transaction-processing subsystems.  Foundation for understanding internal control.  Variety of tools used to design, create, or document accounting information systems (AIS) to achieve organizational objectives.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Cost and Managerial Accounting
courses.description: Cost and managerial accounting topics, including business processes, product costing, cost behavior analysis with regression, breakeven analysis with uncertainty, relevant decision making, performance measurement, variance analysis and budgeting.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Intermediate Financial Accounting 1
courses.description: Advanced financial statement development and evaluation. Ethical reasoning applied to critical business decisions.\n

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Fundamentals of Taxation.
courses.description: Tax principles applicable to business entities and individuals; tax compliance issues; tax planning as part of overall strategic planning process for businesses and individuals.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Financial Statement Auditing
courses.description: This course develops and uses a framework for making judgments in a financial statement auditing context. The audit judgment framework includes a deep understanding of concepts such as the audit risk model, audit evidence, audit sampling and others. This framework is applied to most of the financial statement accounts found in a typical business including revenue, receivables, payables, inventory, fixed assets and other accounts. Other topics covered include professional ethics for accountants and the legal and professional environment affecting financial statement audits.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Accounting Technology
courses.description: Develop skills and abilities to use current technologies in accounting. Learn new ways of thinking to enhance technological readiness.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Critical Thinking in Accounting
courses.description: Equip students with relevant critical thinking and professional judgment knowledge and skills to think critically and evaluate information objectively using approaches such as structured problem solving, research and analysis, design thinking, and good judgment processes.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Integrated Topics in Accounting
courses.description: Capstone cases and projects that integrate concepts from previous accounting coursework.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Accounting Professional Development I
courses.description: Gain essential skills required for professional success in modern accounting. Through combination of lectures, practical exercises, and real-world case studies, students will develop a deeper understanding of ethical decision-making, effective communication, teamwork, and professional behavior.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Accounting Professional Development II
courses.description: Gain essential skills required for professional success in modern accounting. Through combination of lectures, practical exercises, and real-world case studies, students will develop a deeper understanding of ethical decision-making, effective communication, teamwork, and professional behavior.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Financial Statement Analysis
courses.description: Analysis of corporate financial statements emphasizing how accounting and managerial decisions shape reported results. Develop skills to evaluate earnings quality, assess financial risk, and build forward-looking financial projections to inform strategic business and investment decisions.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Money, the Financial System, and the Economy
courses.description: Applications of industry analysis and microeconomic principles in the macroeconomic environment that influences individuals and financial intermediaries that transact in money and credit markets.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Financial Accounting
courses.description: Advanced financial accounting topics including consolidations, accounting for not-for-profit entities, foreign currency translation and remeasurement, and accounting for governmental entities.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Financial Accounting 2
courses.description: Continued intermediate financial statement development and evaluation with some advanced financial topics included.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Accounting Research Seminar
courses.description: Professional standards and professional literature of accounting and auditing; related academic research.  Research tools, information technologies, and critical analysis emphasized.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Introduction to Academic Research
courses.description: Fundamentals of academic research, including the scientific method, the philosophy of science, and the areas and methodologies of academic research.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Academic Archival Research Design
courses.description: Accounting research using archival methodologies.  Focus on reading, interpreting, critiquing, and designing archival research.  Designed for those planning to enter a PhD program.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Academic Experimental Research Design
courses.description: In-depth study of accounting research using experimental methodologies.  Focus on reading, interpreting, critiquing, and designing experimental research.  Designed for those planning to enter a PhD program.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Taxation
courses.description: Tax laws as they apply to selected tax entities, with an introduction to tax research methodology.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Tax Research Methodology
courses.description: In-depth treatment of research and procedures emphasizing communication and presentation of findings.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Accounting Analytics - Professional
courses.description: Build foundational skills in advanced data analytic tools and techniques including obtaining, modifying and analyzing data; understanding statistical concepts in accounting settings; and making data-driven decisions.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Accounting Analytics for Tax
courses.description: Apply an analytic mindset to problems. Learn advanced data analytic tools and techniques including extracting, transforming, and loading data; querying databases; visualizing data; and applying statistical concepts in accounting settings.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Financial Statement Auditing
courses.description: Accounting methodology, professional auditing standards, and current issues.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Management Accounting
courses.description: Advanced concepts, including the role of accounting in strategic and operational decision-making.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Sustainability Reporting for Accountants
courses.description: Explore worldwide sustainability trends and essential non-financial metrics for environmental, social, and governance frameworks and reporting requirements. Develop skills in accounting for and reporting of sustainable practices to add value and meet shifting market needs.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Professional Financial Accounting
courses.description: Advanced financial accounting topics including pensions, earnings per share, accounting changes, and deferred income taxes.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Financial Statement Analysis
courses.description: Analysis of financial statements and the accompanying footnotes.  How various accounting methods might affect interpretation and use of financial information.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Measurement in Accounting
courses.description: Case-based course that examines measurement issues in accounting. Focuses on techniques and approaches used in practice for measuring financial instruments, acquisitions, revenue recognition, and asset impairments, among others. Also focuses on measurements used by entities to report Environmental-Social-Governance (ESG) and Sustainability matters.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: International Accounting and Multinational Enterprises
courses.description: Accounting from an international perspective:  flow of information in multiple currencies, complying with reporting requirements, setting budgets and monitoring performance, and controlling corporate assets through reports and audits.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Forensic Accounting and Fraud Examination
courses.description: Use hands-on cases to 1) develop a forensic mindset and 2) implement data analytics in forensic accounting settings, including financial statement fraud.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Risk Assurance and Information Technology Audit
courses.description: Provide an introduction to IT infrastructure and controls/processes to mitigate security and financial risks associated with IT management. Assists in preparing students for the 2024 CPA exam “Information Systems and Controls (ISC)”.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Introduction to Cyber Risk Assessment in Accounting
courses.description: Introduction to cyber risks and mitigations in accounting from a hacker's point of view. Assists in preparing students for the 2024 CPA exam “Information Systems and Controls (ISC)”.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Applied Accounting Technology
courses.description: Deepen understanding of the application of technology to perform, document, test, attest, and automate accounting procedures and controls through hands-on use of industry leading and emerging technologies.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Enterprise Resource Planning in Accounting
courses.description: Hands-on experience with ERP systems and user applications of key business functions. Students will learn the logic of how to use ERP systems to create budgets, analyze variances, close the books, and generate and interpret management reports.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Applied Accounting Analytics
courses.description: Apply advanced data analytic tools and techniques including obtaining, modifying and analyzing data; applying statistical concepts in accounting settings; and making data-driven decisions in complex business scenarios.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Database Analysis and Design
courses.description: Concepts and techniques of database system development.  Focal areas include: structures, integrity, retrieval, manipulation, validation and analysis.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Management Consulting and Projects
courses.description: Projects-oriented course where students get hands-on experience performing consulting jobs for businesses in Utah.  Class includes both in-class instruction and business experience.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Accounting Technology Hub
courses.description: Develop and post technology challenges on TechHub.training, focusing on essential accounting tools such as Excel, Alteryx, and Tableau. Engage in peer mentoring, enhance technical writing, communication skills, and website design for a global audience.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Corporate Governance
courses.description: How corporate boards are led, focusing especially on the role of the director, the rights of shareholders, the compensation of executives, and the challenge boards face in balancing the needs of shareholders, managers, and other stakeholders.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Special Problems in Federal Taxation
courses.description: Special property transactions, accounting periods and methods, tax payments and credit, tax concepts, and reporting tax liability.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Corporate Taxation 1
courses.description: Federal income taxation of corporations and shareholders.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Corporate Taxation 2
courses.description: Continuation of Corporate Taxation 1.  Includes consolidated returns.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Taxation of Partnerships
courses.description: Federal income taxation of general and limited partnerships and partners.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Current Tax Policy
courses.description: Intensive study of special and current tax topics and policies.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Tax Accounting Methods and Accounting for Income Taxes
courses.description: Accounting periods and methods, corporate income taxation, and accounting for income taxes under ASC 740.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Taxation of Foreign Income
courses.description: Federal taxation of foreign transactions.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Advanced Individual Tax
courses.description: Advanced topics related to issues associated with higher income individual taxpayers.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Healthcare Industry Dynamics
courses.description: A broad study of the many interconnected components of the healthcare industry, including medical technology, pharmaceuticals, hospital administration, healthcare policy, insurance, public health, etc. Introductory applications of various functional skills to healthcare (e.g., accounting, data analytics, ethics, finance, human resources, information systems, marketing, operations, organizational behavior, strategy, supply chain management, and other specializations).

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: State and Local Taxation
courses.description: Introduction to principles of multi-state taxation.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Readings and Conference
courses.description: In-depth study one-on-one with chosen professor on topic of mutual interest not currently covered in existing courses.

courses.subject: ACC
courses.title: Academic Internship: Accounting
courses.description: On-the-job experience and training in industry, government, or public accounting firms.
